rationale: Nate is gaining hands-on experience in AI-driven research automation at SymbyAI, while Sankeerth is building the next generation of practical AI agents at Agentin AI (YC) with deep ML research experience from Google and UC San Diego. Both work in the LLM-tooling and AI research space, making this a valuable opportunity for Nate to learn from a founder actively pushing agent deployment in enterprise workflows.
intro_message: Nate Strum, meet Sankeerth Rao Karingula — he's building practical AI agents at Agentin AI and has the Google Research and ML PhD background that could offer real insight into your work automating scientific workflows at SymbyAI.
